"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Still on what you think happened to us. Thank you. Really."
"Finally. I was wondering when you'd see my value."
"Forget it — go on, I'm listening."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rachel Warren is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Rachel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d42: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d42: 🕯️ Rachel's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d42: 🕯️ Rachel Warren is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Rachel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Rachel's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Rachel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Rodolfo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Shoulder Check (Level 1). You know exactly where to hit something with your shoulder so it goes where YOU want. Shove a controlled monster 2 tiles — into its friends, away from yours.

d42: 📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Rachel Warren, 42 days. The mantle passes to Rodolfo Cruz.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Rodolfo Cruz, 46 — a Rancher. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Green Whisper, Berserker Rage, Dowsing.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Rachel — and Rachel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Ricardo, Addison, Emma and 4 more speak for Rodolfo — "Rachel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Rodolfo before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
